scopeChange: Real-hardware and human-playtesting requirements removed by explicit user instruction. No other outcome waived.

evidenceReuse.note: Reuse explicit: only final runtime difference is the manual-touch practice prompt GAS text, covered by focused assertions. No simulation, geometry, controls, renderer, editor, network or worker behavior differs.

requirements.note: Account-free Quick Race and separate action-based practice finish through legal synthetic-controller input; actual keyboard driving separately verified. This is browser automation, not a human playtest.
Current pause/retry, touch contact cancellation, Settings and actual keyboard driving pass. Historical gamepad checks remain retained; the complete new-renderer gamepad/menu journey was not repeated.
Continuous persisted campaigns and atomic reward tests pass. Complete cup UI/reload journey remains unverified.
All three continuous persisted twelve-event legal-input campaigns pass again. The new renderer draws all twelve tracks; the complete held final-scene UI journey has not been repeated.
All 81 independent build/handling measurements pass. Garage content and tradeoff descriptions are retained; complete current camera/garage UI journey not repeated.

Actual browser Time Trial completes three laps and saves/loads a compatible ghost, retaining a faster prior best. Independent split arithmetic passes. A full improved-best second finish was not added to this fixture.
Injected clock crosses UTC midnight between capture and result; database reopen and upload two days later retain the original challenge and confirm once in a fixture endpoint.
Current Workshop editable DOM, geometry, surface edits, undo/redo, export/import and test entry pass. Complete new-loop creation across every input method remains narrower than the adopted contract.
Current browser edits, saves, exports, tests, returns and reopens the same draft. Five-AI creator context matrix remains incomplete.
Canonical authoritative round trips and hostile/unknown/executable import refusal fixtures pass.
Two stale owner revisions exercised against a uniquely owned provider document; conditional update succeeded and stale revision was refused without replacing the accepted track.
Publication survives catalog failure in isolated fixtures. Actual provider track-success/catalog-conflict/retry journey remains unverified.
Server-stopped fresh document loaded, drove with real keyboard input and saved/reopened an edited draft. Actual browser-process restart is unavailable in the tool and is not claimed.

Normal installed local copy discovered, verified and applied sl-100882d0435165 from sl-de66ac8ab06a61 through game controls with saved progress retained. Final difference is a GAS prompt; worker unchanged. First manual check may finish before installation; second check exposes Apply update. No closed-app notification claim.
Leased two-client timeout-after-acceptance regression passes. Public valid writes/readback pass in both modes; complete two-client public timeout scenario not run.

Canvas failure injection and replacement preserve the paused race and clock. Six viewport layouts and independent pointer cancellation pass; actual offline keyboard input works. No physical-device claim.

Complete invitations and independently decoded scorecard are verified. Browser-executed production sharing fixtures cover success, cancellation without fallback side effects, clipboard fallback and denied-clipboard manual fallback. Navigator APIs are injected; no OS share-sheet or external-message claim.
Audio signals/voice bounds and five scene families were checked in the browser. Complete muted/reduced-motion/low-effects finish journeys remain unverified.
Migration, conflicts, quota/failure-then-navigation, backups and abort/reopen checks pass. Complete crash-boundary matrix remains narrower than the adopted method.
Result and best transaction aborts preserve rewards/best/ghost atomically; same-ID retries retain one consistent record.
Exclusive/expired leases, late responses, closed storage, ambiguous acceptance, full pending capacity and permanent rejection are covered by passing fixtures.
Actual pinned-host conditional writes, wrong credential, stale ETag and ambiguity readback passed. Create-only conflict and full application UI evidence remain incomplete.

Valid Trial/Daily writes and readback succeeded, no duplicate appended, and client expiry/unsupported builds returned 422. Duplicate/split-arithmetic probes sometimes returned a provider module memory-budget error instead of the expected 422; the probe is retained as failed, not relabeled passed. Remaining prohibited-mutation matrix incomplete.

Both public endpoints assigned matching receipt timestamps and five-day expiries. Expiry filtering/cleanup behavior passes local fixtures and synthetic rows were conditionally removed by ETag; no live record was allowed to age through the full five-day retention period.

Public readback verified 24 intended official fragments and missing/unknown/hostile fallback routes. Live native editor opened and saved an editable copy. Earlier method memory-budget 500 is retained; actual injected composition-failure fallback is still narrower than the full adopted method.

No supported provider-wide readiness procedure is available. Public reads/writes are observed; 500 memory-budget and earlier 403 responses remain recorded. Hosts are not presumed to have different capabilities.

Board resource creation/migration was conditional and preserved the zero-row baseline; local migration fixtures prove existing rows are retained. No pre-populated live board existed to verify preservation of real scores during release promotion.
Shared model/source/compiler, collision/handling, transactional editor source, controls and recovery pass current tests; renderer remains a derived view.
Advanced editor tools implemented and current official-copy UI checks pass. Complete new-track keyboard/emulated-touch end-to-end sequence remains incomplete.
All references/builds and continuous seeded campaigns pass. Originals were CLI-authored; editing copies through Workshop does not retroactively satisfy original authoring provenance.
Offline faults, sharing, audio, saved continuation and updates implemented. Actual cold browser-process relaunch unavailable; some exact UI journeys remain incomplete.

Owner publishing and casual boards remain enabled. The browser native-fetch receiver bug is fixed. Localhost board browsing is blocked by provider CORS; same-origin UI needs post-publication readback. Server negative probes contain memory-budget errors.
The user-authorized candidate was published and live assets/routes were verified, but not all product outcomes pass. Full release acceptance remains incomplete.
Both newly authored overhead posters decode; initial OG/Twitter metadata validates in the build. Public readback is separate.
ICO and all declared PNG sizes decode. Tiny/light/dark and mask-safe visual sheet was inspected. Icons are unchanged from that browser check.
Canvas runtime assets, retained editable SVG poster sources, icon sources, fonts/licenses and offline/public inventories validate. No Three.js shipped in the new release.

Hosted commit e908b82 passed all 82 regression tests and rejected incomplete J01 after successful build/identity verification. Both checks are required on the default branch, including for administrators.
Package/deployment share exact source-input identity and stage gates. Missing asset, stale source, missing evidence and failed provider acceptance are refused in isolated copies.
Current remake public assets/routes have not yet been promoted. Previous live readback remains historical; deployment receipt will identify the newly verified publication.
Source identity scans credential-like values; private baselines and dependencies are excluded by explicit package inventory. Deployment input is hidden and credentials remain in RAM.
Conditional A-to-B-to-A root restoration reconciles ambiguity; stale/tampered plans fail before writing; unrelated records and immutable dependencies preserved.

Browser receipt retains its actual release, UA and viewport measurements; screenshot shows final prompt-only candidate. Reuse difference is explicitly hashed. Offline observations and limitations are separately recorded.
101/101 full tests pass; five focused tests cover the final prompt-only change. Other adopted product/provider journeys remain incomplete and no full acceptance is claimed.
